en.answer: The targeted Xyz monster will be attached to your monster as Xyz material, but the Xyz material(s) that was attached to that Xyz monster will be sent to the Graveyard.
en.question: When the effect of <<17256>> attaches an opponent's Xyz monster to your Xyz monster, what happens to the Xyz material of your opponent's monster?
